summary: The change rejects dirty candidate checkouts and adds coverage for staged, unstaged, and untracked descendant edits.

evidence: LocalCheckoutResolver checks porcelain status and returns null before deriving candidate paths when pending edits exist (src/repair/model-port.ts:697-705).
